summary: Iteration 20 — Full backend+frontend coverage of the four new features (Admin Stripe Setup, Analytics upgrade, Landing/Onboarding Keep-More Strip, Gift Tickets). All 13 pytest cases pass and all Playwright UI checks pass. No functional bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.stripe_config correctly validates sk_live_/rk_live_ prefix AND does a live Stripe.Account.retrieve to confirm the key is real before persisting — solid defense.
stripe_config.apply_stripe_keys falls back to test env keys unless BOTH mode==live AND a live secret is saved — good safe default. Consider logging when a live-mode is attempted without a saved key.

studio._analytics_extra: nested per-piece counts loop (saves + likes count_documents per top-viewed item) is O(N*queries). Fine for top 8, but if the limit is raised later, batch into a $lookup or $facet aggregate.

artworks.get_artwork correctly skips view logging when viewer is the artist. Note: any authenticated non-artist view is logged, including admin — expected but consider whether admin views should count for analytics.
payments.gift_event_ticket relies on Field(min_length=5) for email but does its own '@'/'.' sanity check — good. Consider EmailStr for consistency with other endpoints.

events.gift_ticket (public) reveals event id/title/location and refunded/checked_in booleans without auth. Given the token is a random new_id() this is acceptable, but note gift_token is not currently expired. Consider adding an expiry after event.end_at + N days.
KeepMoreStrip: 5 competitor rows + 1 fine-print div means '[data-testid=keep-more-table] > div' returns 6 children; not a bug but tests need to filter the note.
auth.register claims gift RSVPs with unset user_id by email match — good UX. Consider also updating user_name to the newly-registered name, currently retains the tx recipient_name.
test_credentials: admin monster@houseofmonster.com / MonsterAdmin2026!; artist demo.artist@artcorestudio.net / DemoArtist2026!; buyer demo.collector@artcorestudio.net / DemoCollector2026!
seed_data_creation: Test inserted one gift RSVP (ui_gift_test_*) + one gift RSVP via pytest (testtoken_*), one paid event (if not present), and a temporary friend.test@example.com user + test_onboard_* artist for onboarding page verification. ALL cleaned up post-test. Mode restored to 'test'; any temporary stripe_live_* keys cleared from settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_stripe_analytics_gift.py -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables xdist, but session-scoped mongo cleanup fixture is safe under xdist). Frontend flows verified: admin /admin tab-stripe (mode label, claim link, disabled switch-live-btn, empty save toast), studio tab-analytics (visits-chart, followers-chart, follower-delta, top-viewed-grid), landing keep-more-strip (5 rows Art Core/Etsy/Chairish/Saatchi/Singulart + CTA to /register?role=artist), onboarding compact strip (no CTA), paid event EventDetail gift-ticket-btn + full dialog + navigation to stripe checkout, free event has no gift button, /gift/{token} valid + /gift/badtoken error state. NOTE for cleanup: session_id 'cs_test_fake_*' RSVPs must be manually removed if left behind. Landing marquee overflow at 390px was 0 (no marquee-only overflow observed this run).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor test-side fixes: (1) /api/events POST requires Location.lat/lng, (2) /api/events/mine/tickets nests event under .event, (3) demo artist artworks list is at /api/artists/{id} not /artworks. Updated test to reflect actual API contracts.
